summary: Franklin BSP Real Estate Debt, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a $125 million Master Repurchase and Securities Contract Agreement with Morgan Stanley Bank, N.A., through its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary FBRED REIT MSWH Seller, LLC. The facility matures May 27, 2029, with two one-year extension options. The registrant also provided a guarantee. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
